prompt: Although modern technology has made international communication very easy, many businesspeople still travel long distances for business meetings. Do the advantages of face-to-face meetings outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
It is often argued that face-to-face meetings are still commonly used by businesspeople, while online meetings are available with the help of modern devices . While this issue has both advantages and disadvantages, I believe that the benefits are more significant. This essay will discuss both sides of the argument.

There are several drawbacks associated with this matter. One of the main negative points is that travelling a long distance is too expensive for many companies and people. This means that they need to spend a considerable amount of money on business trips, which can have a negative impact on the profit of the business. Another important disadvantage is that it requires a high level of physical energy to atted meeting in different locations during a short period of time. This is often caused by long air trips and jet lag, especially when the meeting locations are far from the original country. For example, a person who lives in Australia and wants to participate in a meeting in Italy may have to travel more than twenty hours by plane.

On the other hand, the benefits of the matter are more significant. One major advantage is that it can decrease the expenses of work-related travel, which can positively affect the financial situation of the company. In addition, the possibility of attending more international daily meetings is another positive point. If this trend continues, it is likely to lead to expanding the company’s business network worldwide. For instance, a person who manages a local firm can easily communicate with many international firms to introduce their products without spending a considerable amount of money on travelling.

In conclusion, although this issue can bring both pros and cons, I believe its pros outweigh the drawbacks because they have more long-lasting and widespread impacts, particularly in terms of expense reduction and network expansion.
